name: MonarchKeyValue
title: KeyValue
summary: Compact metadata as inline label and value pairs, such as "Region eu-west · Plan Team · ID 4f2a…".
whenToUse: For a few facts about a record under its title or in a card: region, plan, owner, an id that can be copied.
whenNotToUse: For a full set of facts on a detail screen, use a list of rows or a description list with one fact per row. For a single status, use MonarchStatusBadge.
api: @Composable fun MonarchKeyValue(items: List<MonarchKeyValueItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, separator: MonarchKeyValueSeparator = MonarchKeyValueSeparator.Dot, size: MonarchKeyValueSize = MonarchKeyValueSize.Sm, layout: MonarchKeyValueLayout = MonarchKeyValueLayout.Wrap, copyIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onCopy: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, emptyLabel: String? = null)
class MonarchKeyValueItem(label: String, value: String?, copyable: Boolean = false, copyValue: String? = null, monospace: Boolean = false)
enum class MonarchKeyValueSeparator { Dot, Divider, None }

options.name: separator
options.description: Dot, Divider or None, between pairs in the wrap layout.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm uses caption text, Md body text.

options.name: layout
options.description: Wrap flows pairs onto more lines; Stack puts each pair on its own line.

options.name: copyIcon
options.description: The icon of the copy buttons. With it the buttons show only the icon; without it they show the word "Copy".

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Called with the copied text after a copy button is used.

options.name: emptyLabel
options.description: What TalkBack reads for an empty value. null uses monarch_keyvalue_empty, "Not set".

options.name: MonarchKeyValueItem.value
options.description: The value; null or empty shows a dash.

options.name: MonarchKeyValueItem.copyable
options.description: Adds a copy button that copies the value.

options.name: MonarchKeyValueItem.copyValue
options.description: Adds a copy button that copies this text instead, such as the full id behind a shortened one.

options.name: MonarchKeyValueItem.monospace
options.description: Draws the value in the code face.

states.name: value
states.description: The label in muted text, then the value in default text.

states.name: empty value
states.description: A dash in muted text, read as "Not set". No copy button.

states.name: copyable
states.description: A ghost MonarchCopyButton after the value, with the word "Copy" or the copy icon.

appearance: Labels are muted text and values default text, in caption or body size; monospaced values use the code face. The dot separator is subtle text; the divider is a one-pixel line in the default border color. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web has KeyValue and KeyValueItem as a container and children with any content as the value; here the pairs are values with text, so separators and copy buttons are placed by the component, as on iOS. The web copy button is icon only; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so without copyIcon the button shows the word "Copy". The web semantics is a description list; Compose has no such role, so each label and value are one TalkBack element read together. iOS shares the name and the options.
accessibility: Each label and its value are one TalkBack element, read label first.
An empty value is shown as a dash and read as "Not set" (or emptyLabel).
A copy button is a separate element named "Copy" followed by the label, for example "Copy ID", with a 48dp touch target; it announces the copy as MonarchCopyButton does.
Pairs and values wrap onto more lines at the largest font size instead of being cut off.
edgeCases: copyable on an empty value shows no copy button.
In the wrap layout a separator belongs to the pair after it, so a line can start with a separator when pairs wrap.

examples.title: Metadata line
examples.template:
MonarchKeyValue(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchKeyValueItem({{items.0.label}}, {{items.0.value}}),
        MonarchKeyValueItem({{items.1.label}}, {{items.1.value}}),
        MonarchKeyValueItem({{items.2.label}}, {{items.2.value}}),
    ),
)
examples.code:
MonarchKeyValue(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchKeyValueItem("Region", "eu-west"),
        MonarchKeyValueItem("Plan", "Team"),
        MonarchKeyValueItem("Seats", "24"),
    ),
)

examples.title: A stack in a narrow card
examples.code:
MonarchKeyValue(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchKeyValueItem("Owner", "Priya Raman"),
        MonarchKeyValueItem("Due", null),
    ),
    layout = MonarchKeyValueLayout.Stack,
    size = MonarchKeyValueSize.Md,
)
